$comment: `bridge`: the last PUBLISHED release that still runs every conversion below; upgrade.json `minFrom` (the support floor) may point at it. Registry of every one-time conversion the core still carries (docs/MIGRATIONS.md). `removableAtFloor`: once upgrade.json `minFrom` reaches this version, every site has already run the conversion in a bridge release, so the code MUST be gone (tests/core/migration-registry.test.mjs fails otherwise). null = not removable by a floor raise (reason given). `present`: files or code symbols that prove the code still exists. `removed`: conversions already deleted, with the floor that made it safe.

active.what: Start-up sweep: pending module data conversions (dataVersion contract), empty legacy settings, old choice texts; runs once per state (core.legacySweepState).
active.why: Permanent contract: a module declares dataVersion and its migrations; the sweep resumes interrupted ones.

backup.why: Module data conversions (dataVersion) are a permanent contract: the restore runs them with the code of the right release of each module (src/core/backup/conversion/moduleChain.ts).

active.what: Old menu (instances shown in the menu + nav.custom) frozen into nav.menu when an instance is created or the navigation page opens; legacy fallback while nav.menu is absent (restored old backup, brand-new site).
active.why: Kept on purpose: a brand-new site has no stored menu, and the fallback (loadMenu / legacyMenuFromDb) builds it. A BACKUP made before the stored menu (nav.menu, 0.2.6) no longer relies on it: the restore freezes the menu inside the data (freezeMenu, src/core/backup/conversion/coreConversions.ts).

removed.what: One-time freeze of overlay placements of existing instances (0.2.6).
Start-up call that froze the menu into nav.menu (the freeze itself stays, see menu-freeze).

Restoring a backup made before 0.1.20: modules/instances that were switched off became uninstalled, data kept. Removed in 0.32.0 with the columns Module.enabled and ModuleInstance.enabled: rows still switched off are set aside by the SQL migration 20261118090000_drop_enabled_columns (data kept, reason "legacy"), and such a backup file is refused (error switched-off).

Handed the old core RAWG key, cover fixes and to-check list to the Game covers module (installed it once): start-up hook, hook after install, update and restore, wait on the first call of an old module. The stored rawg.* settings are left untouched (never read nor deleted any more).

schemaMigrations.$comment: Every Prisma migration that moves or rewrites data (UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, DROP, RENAME) says what a backup made BEFORE it does at restore (tests/core/backup-conversion-coverage.test.mjs). Added columns need nothing: they take their default. kind: automatic (why) | converted (file, symbol) | upgrade (a `schemaUpgrades` entry with this name in src/core/backup/schema.ts).

20261015120000_retired_instances.why: Rebuilds the Module table to add a column; modules are restored from the list in backup.json, never from table rows.

20261101090000_central_journal.why: Rewrites the audit log, which is not part of a backup.
